faults.title: High-pressure fuel pump cam follower and intake cam lobe wear
faults.symptoms: MIL on, fuel rail pressure fluctuation, lack of power and hesitation
codes: P0087 Fuel Rail/System Pressure Too Low
faults.cause: Wear of the intake cam lobe that drives the high-pressure pump, which also wears the base of the cam follower
faults.fix: Remove the pump and inspect follower base and plunger tip; replace the follower; replace the pump only if the plunger tip is worn; oil change after repair if the follower was badly worn. Factory fix: hardened intake cam 06F 109 101 J. Bulletin is for the BPY sister engine; VAG 5-digit codes not found

source.label: VW Group of America TB 2015153 (V151401), 11 Mar 2014, 2.0L BPY
